composition_summary: Reviewed the packet as a component-drafting request for one class-22 PythonCode candidate. The host sink supports class 22 with name/description/content only, so the payload is a single supported constructor draft. The requested semantics are a raw validator: it must inspect candidate data that may be missing, null, wrong-typed or out-of-range and return an explicit invalid-result object (ok=false, entries=[]) rather than raising or coercing. Per the reviewer decision procedure, direct inputs[...] access is incorrect because it raises before the validation decision; use inputs.get with a presence branch. The body defines a helper and must call it and assign its returned value to result at module scope. A boolean is not an integer, so weight must be tested with exact integer semantics and rejected if bool. Extra item fields fail closed. The empty list is a valid selection (cardinality 0..3), so an empty list is valid, not an error. Typed inputs are a target interface, not deployed runtime support; the draft is unapproved and the target typed-input interface is not guaranteed. No provider capabilities were invented; catalogue_revision and protocol_capabilities are null, so no provider-side change is proposed. Conversation preserved exactly; no observed effects, approvals or activations.
